descriptions.description: Lectotype (Amich in Cafferty & Jarvis in Taxon 53: 1052. 2004): [icon] " Ortegia dichotoma, axillis ramorum unifloris " in Allioni, Stirp. Descr. Misc. Taurinensia: 176, t. 4, f. 1. 1766.
" Habitat in Javanium in saxosis. " RCN: 280.
Lectotype (Lopez Gonzalez in Jarvis & al., Regnum Veg. 127: 72. 1993): Loefling s. n., Herb. Linn. No. 53.1 (LINN).
" Habitat in Castilia Minuart. Baetica Velez, Salamantica. " RCN: 279.
Note: See Lopez Gonzalez (in Anales Jard. Bot. Madrid 56: 369 - 370. 1998), who argues that the correct generic form is, as used by Linnaeus in 1753, " Ortega ".
Habitat in Castilia Minuart, Baetica Velez, Salmantica. ☉
1. Ortega. Loefl. epist. VIII: 43. Rubia linifolia aspera. Bauh. pin. 333. Juncaria salmatica. Clus. hist. 1. p. 174.
